text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, fair trainer! My day off was
filled with
utter bliss.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I spent the morning pouring over fan
letters that
sang me the highest praises.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In the afternoon, I had a photo session
for a special issue of collectible prints
that shall serve
as fine gifts for those
fans.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At night, I set off to dreamland under
the
watchful eye of my framed portrait.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I feel refreshed in both mind and body!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I shall commit myself fully to
today's
training! Haaah ha ha ha ha ha!
